name: SAMBA

audit.scope: raw collected files in C:/Users/Mohammed856/finengine-raw-odd (read-only); no network, no data/**, no AWS/Supabase; SHA-256 recomputed for every document listed (16 files in inventory). SAMBA is Samba Financial Group on every cover; overlap with 1180 checked.
audit.method: All 16 files opened (cover or statement pages). Five filings (FY2020, FY2019, Q1, H1 and 9M 2020) had BS, IS and CF rendered and read by eye (statement pages are images); cover and page layout were checked for the other eleven (identical layout BS p3, IS p4, CF p7 in every interim) without reading values. The 1180 raw folder was scanned (first three pages of 59 PDFs, hashes) for Samba overlap. tools/check_transcripts.py (bank identities added: income build, tax, parent plus NCI, CF sum and roll, quarter sums, declared restatements) passes for transcripts/1090.json.

value_correctness.summary: SAR thousand. Bank-format headline values (total assets, liabilities, equity, loans, deposits; total operating income, operating expenses, profit before zakat, zakat and tax, net income, equity-holder and NCI split, basic EPS; cash flow CFO, CFI, CFF, net change, opening and closing cash) transcribed from rendered pages for FY2020, FY2019, Q1 2020, H1 2020, 9M 2020 with comparatives (FY2018 restated, Q1/H1/9M 2019). All identities pass (BS equation, income build, net income after zakat and tax, parent plus NCI, cash-flow sum and roll, six quarter-sum chains including 2019 comparatives). 8 differences declared with both values: 31 Dec 2019 total assets 255,603,801 and liabilities 210,154,969 as originally reported (FY2019 file and all 2020 interims) vs 259,528,248 and 214,079,416 as restated in the FY2020 file (derivatives and presentation change; equity and loans unchanged). Income and cash flow of FY2019 do not differ between filings. Q1 2019 is only available in restated form (Q1 2020 comparatives).

document_completeness.summary: All 16 files are Samba Financial Group statement sets; five were read in full, the other eleven are judged complete only by cover and page layout (BS, income, OCI, equity, CF pages present, mostly image pages inside text PDFs or full scans) and that is NOT confirmed from values, including those the inventory flags partial_statements (6 files), other_no_statements_found (2) and scanned_unreadable (1); the inventory own tally of only 2 files with all three statements and 11 partial comes from text-layer detection that cannot see image pages: the flags reflect image statement pages, not missing statements. Five filings (FY2020, FY2019, Q1, H1, 9M 2020) were read; eleven (2017 Q1/H1/9M, 2018 Q1/H1/9M, FY2017, FY2018, 2019 Q1/H1/9M) were opened to cover level and layout only. 98e8e14c and f472ad56 are Arabic-language filings (no English twin collected). Annual files carry the publication year as fiscal_year.
